name: log-card-keep
description: Structured log, the persistence probe of looks loaded from the card. (1) At the first flush of a session the flush task reads C:\EPM2LOOK.BIN; a file that starts with LOOK (26 bytes or more) sets the art matrix of Pro 400H (0x7ECB0988) as probe 2 did, stores a record LKB1 {u16 18, u16 sum of the 18 bytes, the matrix} at 0x603FC000 in the unused tail of the EEROM settings bank, and calls the bank save API 0x7E680272 (card_keep: its result, the sum). (2) At the first GUI state of every session (log-core's T_GUI, task CA_MAIN), when the tail holds a valid LKB1 record, it writes its matrix into the table (bank_look: status 0 applied, 1 no record, 2 bad length or sum; the table's first two values). At the first flush, before the card file, it logs bank_tail (the number of nonzero words in the unused tail 0x603F74B8-0x60404668, the first word of the record). The firmware saves the bank to flash itself (power-off, sleep, every start). In place of log-card-look, on the specs of builds/debug-log-films-12d.json. It puts the build id 368b6bae84a618c0 of logs/events.json into the block header. DEBUG builds only. See experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/design.md section 8 (P4, P5).
_ram: 1 byte of the log's state block (PST+104); the flush task's block buffer for the read

ops._note: hook (card_read): jmp T_CRD. the flush task's entry (log-core): `movm [d2,d3,a2,a3],(sp)` / `add -64,sp`; task USRTEST_A, started by T_GUI when the GUI enters a menu, playback or the power-off state
hook: jmp T_BANK. log-core's T_GUI entry: at every GUI state (task CA_MAIN)
flush task, block header: build id bytes 0-3 da49b2f5 -> 368b6bae (logs/events.json)
flush task, block header: build id bytes 4-7 e7e62ca7 -> 84a618c0 (logs/events.json)
